notes.title: Update On Crashing Issue For Steam Deck and Mac versions
notes.content: We are aware of ongoing crashing issues with the Steam Deck and Mac versions of the game. While we work to resolve this, we have decided to temporarily disable the ability to purchase the game for these platforms. We deeply apologize for the inconvenience. If you have already purchased the game and are unable to play due to this issue, please contact us via the Steam Community forums or on our social media channels @KoroNekoGame.

notes.title: KORONEKO Fixed: SteamDeck issues have been fixed!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44490624/e50584d876acf5c2e3993cf3b227438d4002ab79.png[/img]



To all SteamDeck users, thank you for waiting!
We have received your feedback regarding SteamDeck issues and we have finally been able to fix it!


Enjoy, and have a relaxing day :)!

notes.title: KoroNeko Patch Notes Version (1.01)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44490624/7e5650825e65b86177211a1c617af7ac1e8e1e4a.jpg[/img]

Patch Notes (1.01):
-    Fixed an issue on unobtainable achievement (The End)
-    Fixed the dimensions of Thank you massage.
-    Fixed the Arabic Credits, Now the Credits will show in Arabic after completing the main campaign. 
-    Fixed an issue where the Restart prompt sometimes doesn’t show up.
-    Fixed an issue of skipping the credits sometimes restart it.
-    Fixed an issue where sometimes characters get blurry in cutscenes.
-    Fixed an issue with the camera zoom-in in The Last Level.
-    Fixed the Sun idle animation.
-    Minor Visual and animation fixes.
